scr1_axi.description: SCR1 RISC-V core with AXI testbench, Verilator FST fixture from the wavepeek repository (real RTL, small design)

rsa256.description: RSA-256 Montgomery multiplier from libfstwriter's integration tests driven with continuous pseudo-random operands (bench/workloads/rsa256/RSA_bench_tb.sv), Verilator, 200k cycles (real RTL, wide datapaths)

rsa256_long.description: Same RSA-256 design and driver, 2M cycles (real RTL, long simulation)

scr1_x8.description: 8 perturbed copies of the SCR1 trace under separate top scopes (11.6k signals; models a multi-core SoC)

long_sparse.description: synthetic: 20k signals, 500k time steps, ~0.1% of signals change per step (long run, few active signals)

many_active.description: synthetic: 200k signals, 1000 cycles, 30% of signals change each cycle (short run, many active signals)

wide_bus.description: synthetic: 64 buses of 256..2048 bits toggling most cycles (wide vectors)

tlm_1m.description: synthetic TLM: 1M CPU instructions -> NoC packets -> slave accesses (3M transactions, ~2.3M relations, 14 attributes per chain)

ooo_1m.description: synthetic Kanata pipeline log of a 4-wide out-of-order core, 1M instructions (~8M stages, ~9M relations)
